'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import LoadedImage from '@/components/LoadedImage'
import { useCartStore } from '@/lib/cart-store'
import { BadgeCheck, Flame, ShoppingCart, Star } from 'lucide-react'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/Badge'

type ProductCardProduct = {
  id: string
  name: string
  price: number
  priceDisplay?: string | null
  images?: string[]
  isHot?: boolean
  isNew?: boolean
  isDeal?: boolean
  deliveryEstimate?: string | null
  seller?: { id?: string; name?: string; trustLevel?: string; avgRating?: number }
  avgRating?: number
  totalReviews?: number
  quantity?: number
  category?: string
  subcategory?: string | null
  categoryKey?: string | null
  subcategoryKey?: string | null
  variantId?: string
  selectedVariants?: Record<string, string>
}

function fmt(price: number) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-NG', { style: 'currency', currency: 'NGN', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(price)
}

function TrustBadge({ trustLevel }: { trustLevel?: string }) {
  if (!trustLevel) return null
  const label = trustLevel === 'VERIFIED' ? 'Verified' : trustLevel === 'GOLD' ? 'Top seller' : trustLevel
  return (
    <Badge status="verified" icon={BadgeCheck} className="text-[10px]">
      {label}
    </Badge>
  )
}

// Design bible section 8 — Product card. Element order: photo → title →
// seller/verified → rating → price → delivery badge → stock status.
// (Wishlist toggle is omitted: there is no wishlist API/store in this app yet,
// and a heart icon with no destination would violate the "no dead buttons" rule.)
export default function ProductCard({
  product,
  layout = 'grid',
  onOpen,
  showSeller = true,
  className = '',
  priority = false,
}: {
  product: ProductCardProduct
  layout?: 'grid' | 'list'
  onOpen?: () => void
  showSeller?: boolean
  className?: string
  priority?: boolean
}) {
  const addItem = useCartStore((state) => state.addItem)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [toast, setToast] = useState('')

  const image = product.images?.[0] || '/placeholder.png'
  const rating = product.avgRating ?? product.seller?.avgRating ?? 0
  const price = product.priceDisplay || fmt(product.price)
  const stock = product.quantity ?? 0

  const handleQuickAdd = async () => {
    if (loading) return
    setLoading(true)
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/cart/add', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ productId: product.id, quantity: 1 }),
      })
      const data = await res.json()
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.error || 'Failed to add')

      addItem({
        productId: product.id,
        variantId: product.variantId,
        name: product.name,
        price: product.price,
        quantity: 1,
        maxQuantity: stock || 1,
        image,
        sellerId: product.seller?.id || '',
        sellerName: product.seller?.name || 'Seller',
        selectedVariants: product.selectedVariants,
        category: product.category,
        subcategory: product.subcategory || undefined,
        deliveryEstimate: product.deliveryEstimate || undefined,
      })
      setToast('Added')
      setTimeout(() => setToast(''), 1500)
    } catch {
      setToast('Failed')
      setTimeout(() => setToast(''), 1500)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  if (layout === 'list') {
    return (
      <article className={`group overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-white transition-transform duration-150 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 ${className}`}>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row">
          <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="relative aspect-square w-full sm:w-52 flex-shrink-0 bg-surface text-left">
            <LoadedImage src={image} alt={product.name} className="transition duration-500 group-hover:scale-105" wrapperClassName="h-full w-full" priority={priority} />
            <div className="absolute left-3 top-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {product.isHot && <Badge status="warning" icon={Flame}>Hot</Badge>}
              {product.isNew && <Badge status="new">New</Badge>}
              {product.isDeal && <Badge status="success">Deal</Badge>}
            </div>
          </button>
          <div className="flex-1 p-4 sm:p-5">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="text-left">
                  <h3 className="line-clamp-2 text-[16px] font-medium leading-snug text-ink">{product.name}</h3>
                </button>
                {showSeller && (
                  <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-ink-secondary">
                    <span className="font-medium text-ink-secondary">{product.seller?.name || 'Seller'}</span>
                    <TrustBadge trustLevel={product.seller?.trustLevel} />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <p className="text-[18px] font-semibold text-ink">{price}</p>
                {rating > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-ink-secondary">
                    <Star className="h-3 w-3 fill-warning text-warning" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                    {rating.toFixed(1)}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
              {product.deliveryEstimate && <span className="rounded-md bg-surface px-2.5 py-1 font-medium text-ink-secondary">{product.deliveryEstimate}</span>}
              {stock === 0 && <Badge status="out-of-stock">Out of stock</Badge>}
              {stock > 0 && stock <= 5 && <Badge status="low-stock">Only {stock} left</Badge>}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={handleQuickAdd} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-all duration-150 hover:brightness-95 active:scale-[0.98]">
                <ShoppingCart className="h-4 w-4" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                {loading ? 'Adding…' : 'Add to cart'}
              </button>
              <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-ink transition-all duration-150 hover:bg-surface">
                View
              </button>
            </div>
            {toast && <p className="mt-2 text-xs font-medium text-success">{toast}</p>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    )
  }

  return (
    <article className={`group overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border bg-white transition-transform duration-150 ease-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 ${className}`}>
      <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="relative aspect-square w-full bg-surface text-left">
        <LoadedImage src={image} alt={product.name} className="transition duration-500 group-hover:scale-105" wrapperClassName="h-full w-full" priority={priority} />
        <div className="absolute left-3 top-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {product.isHot && <Badge status="warning" icon={Flame}>Hot</Badge>}
          {product.isNew && <Badge status="new">New</Badge>}
          {product.isDeal && <Badge status="success">Deal</Badge>}
        </div>
        <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 rounded-md bg-white/92 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-ink-secondary backdrop-blur">
          {product.deliveryEstimate || (stock > 0 ? `${stock} left` : 'Out of stock')}
        </div>
        {toast && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-3 right-3 rounded-md bg-white/92 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-success backdrop-blur">
            {toast}
          </div>
        )}
      </button>

      <div className="p-4">
        <button type="button" onClick={onOpen} className="text-left">
          <h3 className="line-clamp-2 text-[15px] font-medium leading-snug text-ink">{product.name}</h3>
        </button>
        {showSeller && (
          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-ink-secondary">
            <span className="font-medium text-ink-secondary">{product.seller?.name || 'Seller'}</span>
            <TrustBadge trustLevel={product.seller?.trustLevel} />
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <p className="text-[17px] font-semibold text-ink">{price}</p>
          {rating > 0 && (
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-ink-secondary">
              <Star className="h-3 w-3 fill-warning text-warning" strokeWidth={1.75} />
              {rating.toFixed(1)}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {stock === 0 ? (
          <div className="mt-3">
            <Badge status="out-of-stock">Out of stock</Badge>
          </div>
        ) : stock <= 5 ? (
          <div className="mt-3">
            <Badge status="low-stock">Only {stock} left</Badge>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <button type="button" onClick={handleQuickAdd} className="mt-4 inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-primary px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-all duration-150 hover:brightness-95 active:scale-[0.98]">
          <ShoppingCart className="h-4 w-4" strokeWidth={1.75} />
          {loading ? 'Adding…' : 'Add to cart'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </article>
  )
}
components/PWARegister.tsx
'use client'

// components/PWARegister.tsx
// Registers the service worker and sets up token message handler
// so the SW can re-subscribe when push subscription auto-refreshes.

import { useEffect } from 'react'

export default function PWARegister() {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return

    // Register SW
    navigator.serviceWorker
      .register('/sw.js', { scope: '/' })
      .then((registration) => {
        console.log('[PWA] Service worker registered:', registration.scope)
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.error('[PWA] Service worker registration failed:', err)
      })

    // Listen for token requests from the service worker
    // (used during pushsubscriptionchange to re-save the subscription)
    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
      if (event.data?.type === 'GET_TOKEN') {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
        event.ports[0]?.postMessage(token)
      }
    })
  }, [])

  return null
}
components/SearchAutocomplete.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { ChevronDown, Clock3, Search, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react'

type Suggestion = {
  text: string
  category?: string
  type: 'product' | 'category' | 'popular'
}

function highlightMatch(text: string, query: string) {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!q) return text
  const index = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)
  if (index < 0) return text
  return (
    <>
      {text.slice(0, index)}
      <strong>{text.slice(index, index + q.length)}</strong>
      {text.slice(index + q.length)}
    </>
  )
}

export default function SearchAutocomplete({
  value,
  onChange,
  onSubmit,
  onSelect,
  placeholder = 'Search products, sellers, categories...',
}: {
  value: string
  onChange: (value: string) => void
  onSubmit: () => void
  onSelect?: (value: string) => void
  placeholder?: string
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [recent, setRecent] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [popular, setPopular] = useState<Suggestion[]>([])
  const [live, setLive] = useState<Suggestion[]>([])
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null)

  const trimmed = value.trim()

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('batamart_recent_searches') || '[]')
      if (Array.isArray(saved)) setRecent(saved.filter((item) => typeof item === 'string').slice(0, 5))
    } catch {
      setRecent([])
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadPopular = async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/search/suggestions?type=popular&limit=6')
        const data = await res.json()
        setPopular(Array.isArray(data?.suggestions) ? data.suggestions : [])
      } catch {
        setPopular([])
      }
    }
    loadPopular()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return
    if (!trimmed) {
      setLive([])
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    setLoading(true)
    const id = window.setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/search/suggestions?q=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}&limit=8`)
        const data = await res.json()
        setLive(Array.isArray(data?.suggestions) ? data.suggestions : [])
      } catch {
        setLive([])
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    }, 200)

    return () => window.clearTimeout(id)
  }, [trimmed, open])

  const suggestions = useMemo(() => (trimmed ? live : [...recent.map((text) => ({ text, type: 'popular' as const })), ...popular]), [trimmed, recent, popular, live])

  useEffect(() => {
    const onClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = event.target as Node
      if (inputRef.current && !inputRef.current.parentElement?.contains(target)) setOpen(false)
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onClick)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onClick)
  }, [])

  const saveRecent = (query: string) => {
    const next = [query, ...recent.filter((item) => item.toLowerCase() !== query.toLowerCase())].slice(0, 10)
    setRecent(next)
    localStorage.setItem('batamart_recent_searches', JSON.stringify(next))
  }

  const choose = (text: string) => {
    onChange(text)
    onSelect?.(text)
    saveRecent(text)
    setOpen(false)
    setActiveIndex(-1)
    window.setTimeout(onSubmit, 0)
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 shadow-sm transition focus-within:border-indigo-300 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-[#272b33] dark:bg-[#0f1115] dark:focus-within:ring-indigo-900/30">
        <Search className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-400 dark:text-[#72819a]" />
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => {
            onChange(e.target.value)
            setOpen(true)
            setActiveIndex(-1)
          }}
          onFocus={() => setOpen(true)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
              setOpen(false)
              return
            }
            if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
              e.preventDefault()
              setActiveIndex((curr) => Math.min(curr + 1, suggestions.length - 1))
              return
            }
            if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
              e.preventDefault()
              setActiveIndex((curr) => Math.max(curr - 1, 0))
              return
            }
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
              e.preventDefault()
              const chosen = suggestions[activeIndex]?.text || value
              if (chosen) choose(chosen)
              else onSubmit()
            }
          }}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm text-gray-900 outline-none placeholder:text-gray-400 dark:text-[#e5e7eb] dark:placeholder:text-[#72819a]"
        />
        {trimmed ? (
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { onChange(''); setLive([]) }} className="rounded-full p-1 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-white/5">
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 rotate-90" />
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      {open && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-[calc(100%+8px)] z-50 overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-gray-100 bg-white shadow-2xl dark:border-[#272b33] dark:bg-[#0f1115]">
          {!trimmed && (
            <div className="border-b border-gray-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-[#272b33]">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 dark:text-[#72819a]">Recent searches</p>
              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {recent.length > 0 ? recent.map((item) => (
                  <button key={item} type="button" onClick={() => choose(item)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gray-50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:bg-[#141821] dark:text-[#d1d5db]">
                    <Clock3 className="h-3 w-3" /> {item}
                  </button>
                )) : <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-[#72819a]">No recent searches yet.</span>}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="px-4 py-3">
            <p className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 dark:text-[#72819a]">{trimmed ? 'Suggestions' : 'Popular searches'}</p>
            {loading && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-[#72819a]">Searching...</p>}
            <div className="mt-2 space-y-1">
              {(trimmed ? live : popular).length > 0 ? (trimmed ? live : popular).map((item, index) => (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  key={`${item.type}-${item.text}-${index}`}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setActiveIndex(index)}
                  onClick={() => choose(item.text)}
                  className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 text-left transition ${activeIndex === index ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-white/8' : 'hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-white/5'}`}
                >
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800 dark:text-[#e5e7eb]">
                    {trimmed ? highlightMatch(item.text, trimmed) : item.text}
                  </span>
                  <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-black text-gray-500 dark:bg-[#1a1f2a] dark:text-[#94a3b8]">
                    {item.category || (item.type === 'popular' ? 'Popular' : item.type)}
                  </span>
                </button>
              )) : (
                <div className="py-4 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-[#94a3b8]">No suggestions found.</div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="border-t border-gray-100 px-4 py-3 dark:border-[#272b33]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500 dark:text-[#94a3b8]">
              <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Tip: press Enter to search, Esc to close.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
components/SplashScreen.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter, usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'

function preloadImage(src: string): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const img = new window.Image()
    img.onload = () => resolve()
    img.onerror = () => resolve()
    img.src = src
  })
}

function unblockPage() {
  document.documentElement.classList.remove('splash-pending')
}

function isAppModeNow(): boolean {
  return (
    window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
    (window.navigator as any).standalone === true ||
    window.location.search.indexOf('app=true') !== -1
  )
}

// Exported helper
// Called synchronously by MarketplacePage on first render to decide whether
// to show a blank white screen while splash is active.
export function isSplashPending(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false
  try {
    const isAndroid = window.location.search.indexOf('android=true') !== -1

    if (isAndroid) return false

    // Splash is app/PWA mode only.
    if (isAppModeNow() && !sessionStorage.getItem('batamart_splash_app')) return true

    return false
  } catch {
    return false
  }
}

export default function SplashScreen() {
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState<boolean>(() => isSplashPending())
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'idle' | 'in' | 'out'>('idle')

  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()

  useEffect(() => {
    let outTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
    let doneTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null
    let cancelled = false

    const isAndroid = searchParams.get('android') === 'true'
    const isAppMode = isAppModeNow()

    // Android has its own native splash - unblock page immediately
    if (isAndroid) {
      setVisible(false)
      unblockPage()
      return
    }

    const shouldShowAppSplash =
      isAppMode && !sessionStorage.getItem('batamart_splash_app')

    // No splash needed - unblock immediately and signal done
    if (!shouldShowAppSplash) {
      setVisible(false)
      unblockPage()
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('batamart:splash-done'))
      return
    }

    // Mark session so splash doesn't repeat
    sessionStorage.setItem('batamart_splash_app', '1')
    setPhase('idle')

    // Preload logo fully before showing anything
    preloadImage('/BATAMART - logo.png').then(() => {
      if (cancelled) return

      setVisible(true)

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          if (!cancelled) setPhase('in')
        })
      })

      outTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setPhase('out')
      }, 2500)

      doneTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (cancelled) return

        setVisible(false)
        unblockPage()
        // Signal marketplace page that splash is finished
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('batamart:splash-done'))
        if (isAppMode && pathname === '/') {
          router.replace('/marketplace?app=true')
        }
      }, 3000)
    })

    return () => {
      cancelled = true
      if (outTimer) clearTimeout(outTimer)
      if (doneTimer) clearTimeout(doneTimer)
    }
  }, [pathname, searchParams, router])

  if (!visible) return null

  const logoStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    opacity: phase === 'in' ? 1 : 0,
    transform: phase === 'out' ? 'translateY(-8px)' : 'translateY(0)',
    transition:
      phase === 'in'
        ? 'opacity 700ms cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) 200ms'
        : phase === 'out'
          ? 'opacity 400ms ease, transform 400ms ease'
          : 'none',
  }

  const textStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    opacity: phase === 'in' ? 1 : 0,
    transform:
      phase === 'in' ? 'translateY(0)'
        : phase === 'out' ? 'translateY(-20px)'
          : 'translateY(30px)',
    transition:
      phase === 'in'
        ? 'opacity 700ms cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) 600ms, transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) 600ms'
        : phase === 'out'
          ? 'opacity 400ms ease, transform 400ms ease'
          : 'none',
  }

  return (
    <div
      id="__splash_screen"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-white"
    >
      <img
        src="/BATAMART - logo.png"
        alt="BataMart"
        style={{
          width: '280px',
          height: '120px',
          objectFit: 'contain',
          ...logoStyle,
        }}
      />
      <p
        style={{
          marginTop: '12px',
          color: '#4DABFF',
          fontSize: '16px',
          fontWeight: 600,
          ...textStyle,
        }}
      >
        Campus Marketplace
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}
components/auth/GoogleAuthButton.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

declare global {
  interface Window {
    google?: any
  }
}

type GoogleAuthButtonProps = {
  mode: 'login' | 'signup'
  payload?: Record<string, unknown>
  onError?: (message: string) => void
  onLoading?: (loading: boolean) => void
  onSuccess?: (data: any) => void
}

export default function GoogleAuthButton({
  mode,
  payload,
  onError,
  onLoading,
  onSuccess,
}: GoogleAuthButtonProps) {
  const buttonRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null)
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false)
  const [scriptError, setScriptError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const clientId = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!clientId) return
    const scriptId = 'google-gsi-client'
    if (!document.getElementById(scriptId)) {
      const script = document.createElement('script')
      script.id = scriptId
      script.src = 'https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client'
      script.async = true
      script.defer = true
      script.onload = () => setReady(true)
      script.onerror = () => setScriptError('Could not load Google Sign-In script.')
      document.head.appendChild(script)
    } else {
      setReady(true)
    }
  }, [clientId])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready || !buttonRef.current || !window.google || !clientId) return

    const handleCredentialResponse = async (response: { credential?: string }) => {
      const idToken = response?.credential
      if (!idToken) {
        onError?.('Google sign-in failed. Please try again.')
        return
      }

      onLoading?.(true)
      onError?.('')
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/auth/google', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            idToken,
            mode,
            ...(payload ?? {}),
          }),
        })

        const data = await res.json()
        if (!res.ok) {
          onError?.(data.error || 'Google sign-in failed')
          return
        }

        if (onSuccess) {
          onSuccess(data)
          return
        }

        localStorage.setItem('token', data.token)
        localStorage.setItem('userName', data.user.name)
        localStorage.setItem('userRole', data.user.role || '')
        localStorage.setItem('userId', data.user.id)
        document.cookie = `token=${data.token}; path=/; SameSite=Lax; max-age=${60 * 60 * 24 * 7}`
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('auth-change'))
        window.location.href = '/marketplace'
      } catch {
        onError?.('Network error. Please try again.')
      } finally {
        onLoading?.(false)
      }
    }

    window.google.accounts.id.initialize({
      client_id: clientId,
      callback: handleCredentialResponse,
      auto_select: false,
      cancel_on_tap_outside: true,
    })

    buttonRef.current.innerHTML = ''
    window.google.accounts.id.renderButton(buttonRef.current, {
      theme: 'outline',
      size: 'large',
      shape: 'rectangular',
      width: 320,
      text: mode === 'signup' ? 'signup_with' : 'signin_with',
    })
  }, [ready, clientId, mode, payload, onError, onLoading, onSuccess])

  if (!clientId) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full text-center text-xs text-warning bg-warning/5 border border-warning/20 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
        Google Sign-In is not configured. Add NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (scriptError) {
    return (
      <div className="w-full text-center text-xs text-danger bg-danger/5 border border-danger/20 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
        {scriptError}
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <div ref={buttonRef} className="w-full flex justify-center" />
      {!ready && (
        <div className="mt-2 text-center text-xs text-ink-muted">
          Loading Google sign-in…
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
components/layout/AppNavigationCache.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'

const CACHE_PREFIX = 'batamart:session-fetch:'
const SCROLL_PREFIX = 'batamart:scroll:'

function isReloadNavigation() {
  const nav = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0] as PerformanceNavigationTiming | undefined
  return nav?.type === 'reload'
}

function clearSessionFetchCache() {
  try {
    for (let i = sessionStorage.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
      const key = sessionStorage.key(i)
      if (key?.startsWith(CACHE_PREFIX)) sessionStorage.removeItem(key)
    }
  } catch {}
}

function simpleHash(input: string) {
  let hash = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i += 1) {
    hash = ((hash << 5) - hash + input.charCodeAt(i)) | 0
  }
  return Math.abs(hash).toString(36)
}

function headersToObject(headers: Headers) {
  const out: Record<string, string> = {}
  headers.forEach((value, key) => {
    const lower = key.toLowerCase()
    if (['content-type', 'cache-control', 'etag', 'last-modified'].includes(lower)) out[key] = value
  })
  return out
}

function shouldCacheRequest(input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) {
  const method = (init?.method || (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
  if (method !== 'GET') return false
  if (init?.cache === 'no-store' || init?.cache === 'reload' || init?.cache === 'no-cache') return false

  let url: URL
  try {
    url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), window.location.origin)
  } catch {
    return false
  }

  if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return false
  if (!url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return false
  if (url.pathname.includes('/live-location')) return false
  if (url.pathname.includes('/payments/')) return false
  if (url.pathname.includes('/upload')) return false
  return true
}

function authPart(init?: RequestInit) {
  try {
    const headers = new Headers(init?.headers || {})
    return headers.get('authorization') || ''
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

function installFetchCache() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {}
  const w = window as typeof window & {
    __batamartFetchCacheInstalled?: boolean
    __batamartOriginalFetch?: typeof fetch
  }
  if (w.__batamartFetchCacheInstalled) return () => {}

  const originalFetch = window.fetch.bind(window)
  w.__batamartOriginalFetch = originalFetch
  w.__batamartFetchCacheInstalled = true

  window.fetch = async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => {
    if (!shouldCacheRequest(input, init)) return originalFetch(input, init)

    const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), window.location.origin)
    const key = `${CACHE_PREFIX}${simpleHash(`${url.href}|${authPart(init)}`)}`

    try {
      const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(key)
      if (cached) {
        const record = JSON.parse(cached) as {
          body: string
          status: number
          statusText: string
          headers: Record<string, string>
        }
        return new Response(record.body, {
          status: record.status,
          statusText: record.statusText,
          headers: record.headers,
        })
      }
    } catch {}

    const response = await originalFetch(input, init)
    if (response.ok) {
      try {
        const clone = response.clone()
        const body = await clone.text()
        sessionStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({
          body,
          status: response.status,
          statusText: response.statusText,
          headers: headersToObject(response.headers),
        }))
      } catch {}
    }
    return response
  }

  return () => {
    if (w.__batamartOriginalFetch) window.fetch = w.__batamartOriginalFetch
    w.__batamartFetchCacheInstalled = false
  }
}

export function AppNavigationCache() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const routeKey = `${pathname || '/'}?${searchParams.toString()}`

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isReloadNavigation()) clearSessionFetchCache()
    const cleanup = installFetchCache()

    const clearHandler = () => clearSessionFetchCache()
    window.addEventListener('batamart:clear-session-cache', clearHandler)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('batamart:clear-session-cache', clearHandler)
      cleanup()
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if ('scrollRestoration' in history) history.scrollRestoration = 'manual'
    const key = `${SCROLL_PREFIX}${routeKey}`
    const container = document.getElementById('ios-scroll-area') || window

    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      try {
        const saved = Number(sessionStorage.getItem(key) || 0)
        if (!Number.isFinite(saved) || saved <= 0) return
        if (container === window) window.scrollTo({ top: saved, behavior: 'instant' as ScrollBehavior })
        else (container as HTMLElement).scrollTop = saved
      } catch {}
    })

    const save = () => {
      try {
        const top = container === window ? window.scrollY : (container as HTMLElement).scrollTop
        sessionStorage.setItem(key, String(top))
      } catch {}
    }

    const target = container === window ? window : (container as HTMLElement)
    target.addEventListener('scroll', save, { passive: true })
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', save)

    return () => {
      save()
      target.removeEventListener('scroll', save)
      window.removeEventListener('pagehide', save)
    }
  }, [routeKey])

  return null
}
components/layout/AppScrollFix.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState, Suspense } from 'react'
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'

function AppScrollFixInner({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const isAppParam = searchParams.get('app') === 'true'
  const isAndroid = searchParams.get('android') === 'true'

  const [isStandalone, setIsStandalone] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)')
    setIsStandalone(mq.matches)
    const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setIsStandalone(e.matches)
    mq.addEventListener('change', handler)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler)
  }, [])

  const isApp = isAppParam || isStandalone || isAndroid

  return (
    <div id="page-scroll-container" className={isApp ? 'pb-nav' : ''}>
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

export function AppScrollFix({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div id="page-scroll-container">{children}</div>}>
      <AppScrollFixInner>{children}</AppScrollFixInner>
    </Suspense>
  )
}
components/layout/GlobalPullToRefresh.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react'

const PULL_THRESHOLD = 80
const PULL_MAX = 110
const PULL_DEAD_ZONE = 8
const PULL_RESIST = 0.4

function isMarketplace(pathname: string | null) {
  return pathname === '/marketplace'
}

export function GlobalPullToRefresh() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const [pullDistance, setPullDistance] = useState(0)
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    let startY = 0
    let deltaY = 0
    let active = false
    let locked = false

    const getScrollTop = () => {
      const iosArea = document.getElementById('ios-scroll-area')
      return iosArea ? iosArea.scrollTop : window.scrollY
    }

    const onTouchStart = (event: TouchEvent) => {
      if (getScrollTop() > 0) {
        startY = 0
        deltaY = 0
        active = false
        locked = false
        return
      }

      startY = event.touches[0]?.clientY || 0
      deltaY = 0
      active = false
      locked = false
    }

    const onTouchMove = (event: TouchEvent) => {
      if (startY === 0) return

      const currentY = event.touches[0]?.clientY || 0
      const delta = currentY - startY
      if (delta <= 0 || delta < PULL_DEAD_ZONE) return

      if (!locked) {
        locked = true
        active = true
      }

      deltaY = delta
      setPullDistance(Math.min(delta * PULL_RESIST, PULL_MAX))
    }

    const onTouchEnd = () => {
      if (!active) return
      const triggered = deltaY * PULL_RESIST >= PULL_THRESHOLD

      active = false
      locked = false
      startY = 0

      if (triggered) {
        setRefreshing(true)
        setPullDistance(PULL_THRESHOLD)
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('batamart:clear-session-cache'))
        if (navigator.serviceWorker?.controller) {
          navigator.serviceWorker.controller.postMessage({ type: 'CLEAR_RUNTIME_CACHE' })
        }
        window.setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 120)
        return
      }

      setPullDistance(0)
    }

    document.addEventListener('touchstart', onTouchStart, { passive: true })
    document.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: true })
    document.addEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd, { passive: true })

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', onTouchStart)
      document.removeEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove)
      document.removeEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd)
    }
  }, [pathname])

  if (pullDistance <= 0) return null

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed left-1/2 top-3 z-[9999] -translate-x-1/2 pointer-events-none"
      style={{ transform: `translate(-50%, ${Math.max(0, pullDistance - 48)}px)` }}
    >
      <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white shadow-soft border border-border">
        <RefreshCw
          className={`h-5 w-5 text-primary ${refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`}
          strokeWidth={1.75}
          style={{ transform: refreshing ? undefined : `rotate(${pullDistance * 2}deg)` }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
components/layout/IOSAppShell.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState, Suspense } from 'react'
import { useSearchParams, usePathname } from 'next/navigation'

function IOSAppShellInner({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const isAppParam = searchParams.get('app') === 'true'
  const isAndroid = searchParams.get('android') === 'true'

  const [isIOS, setIsIOS] = useState(false)
  const [isStandalone, setIsStandalone] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const ios = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) && !(window as any).MSStream
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)')
    setIsIOS(ios)
    setIsStandalone(mq.matches)
    const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setIsStandalone(e.matches)
    mq.addEventListener('change', handler)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler)
  }, [])

  const isApp = isAppParam || isStandalone
  const isIOSApp = isIOS && isApp && !isAndroid

  useEffect(() => {
    const html = document.documentElement
    if (isApp) {
      html.classList.add('app-mode')
    } else {
      html.classList.remove('app-mode')
    }
    return () => html.classList.remove('app-mode')
  }, [isApp])

  if (isIOSApp) {
    return (
      <div
        id="ios-app-shell"
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          overflow: 'hidden',
          // Push content below the fixed top navbar (h-14 = 56px)
          paddingTop: '56px',
          // Account for iOS safe area at bottom
          paddingBottom: 'env(safe-area-inset-bottom)',
        }}
      >
        {/* This div is the ONLY thing that scrolls */}
        <div
          id="ios-scroll-area"
          key={pathname || 'root'}
          className="app-route-enter"
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            overflowY: 'scroll',
            overflowX: 'hidden',
            // Critical — tells iOS this is the scroll container
            WebkitOverflowScrolling: 'touch',
            // Bottom padding so content clears the bottom nav (64px)
            paddingBottom: '64px',
          }}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Non-iOS or browser — render normally, no shell
  return (
    <div
      id="page-scroll-container"
      key={pathname || 'root'}
      className={isApp ? 'app-route-enter' : ''}
      style={{ paddingBottom: 'calc(64px + max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 16px))' }}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

export function IOSAppShell({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div id="page-scroll-container">{children}</div>}>
      <IOSAppShellInner>{children}</IOSAppShellInner>
    </Suspense>
  )
}
components/layout/KeyboardVisibilityProvider.tsx
'use client'

import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'

type KeyboardVisibilityContextValue = {
  isKeyboardOpen: boolean
}

const KeyboardVisibilityContext = createContext<KeyboardVisibilityContextValue>({
  isKeyboardOpen: false,
})

function isFocusableTextTarget(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return false
  const tag = target.tagName
  return tag === 'INPUT' || tag === 'TEXTAREA' || target.isContentEditable
}

export function KeyboardVisibilityProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [isFocusOpen, setIsFocusOpen] = useState(false)
  const [isViewportOpen, setIsViewportOpen] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const evaluateViewport = () => {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
      const viewport = window.visualViewport
      if (!viewport) {
        setIsViewportOpen(false)
        return
      }
      const keyboardHeight = window.innerHeight - viewport.height
      setIsViewportOpen(keyboardHeight > 150)
    }

    const onFocusIn = (event: FocusEvent) => {
      if (isFocusableTextTarget(event.target)) {
        setIsFocusOpen(true)
      }
    }

    const onFocusOut = () => {
      window.setTimeout(() => {
        const active = document.activeElement
        setIsFocusOpen(isFocusableTextTarget(active))
      }, 0)
    }

    document.addEventListener('focusin', onFocusIn)
    document.addEventListener('focusout', onFocusOut)
    evaluateViewport()

    const viewport = window.visualViewport
    if (viewport) {
      viewport.addEventListener('resize', evaluateViewport)
      viewport.addEventListener('scroll', evaluateViewport)
    }

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('focusin', onFocusIn)
      document.removeEventListener('focusout', onFocusOut)
      if (viewport) {
        viewport.removeEventListener('resize', evaluateViewport)
        viewport.removeEventListener('scroll', evaluateViewport)
      }
    }
  }, [])

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ isKeyboardOpen: isFocusOpen || isViewportOpen }),
    [isFocusOpen, isViewportOpen]
  )

  return (
    <KeyboardVisibilityContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </KeyboardVisibilityContext.Provider>
  )
}

export function useKeyboardVisibility() {
  return useContext(KeyboardVisibilityContext)
}
components/layout/Logo.tsx
import Link from 'next/link'

// Design bible section 7 — Logo. Flat single-color mark (not a shopping-bag
// glyph): a rounded square with a path-mark built from two stacked chevrons
// forming a simple "route/delivery" motif, plus a wordmark lockup. Works
// standalone (app icon/favicon) or with the wordmark (navbar).
export function LogoMark({ size = 32, className = '' }: { size?: number; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" className={className} aria-hidden="true">
      <rect width="32" height="32" rx="8" fill="#1E90FF" />
      <path d="M9 20L16 13L23 20" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
      <path d="M9 13.5L16 6.5L23 13.5" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" opacity="0.55" />
    </svg>
  )
}

export function Logo({ href = '/', showWordmark = true, size = 32, className = '' }: { href?: string; showWordmark?: boolean; size?: number; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <Link href={href} className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${className}`}>
      <LogoMark size={size} />
      {showWordmark && (
        <span className="text-[18px] font-semibold text-ink leading-none">BataMart</span>
      )}
    </Link>
  )
}

'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useRouter, usePathname, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
import { useCartStore } from '@/lib/cart-store'
import NotificationBell from '@/components/layout/NotificationBell'
import {
  ChevronDown, User, LogOut, Store, ShoppingBag, Wallet,
  Package, AlertTriangle, PlusCircle, Globe, Plus, Bike,
  LayoutGrid, Bell as BellIcon, Menu, X,
} from 'lucide-react'

import { isSplashPending } from '@/components/SplashScreen'
import { useKeyboardVisibility } from '@/components/layout/KeyboardVisibilityProvider'
import { Logo } from '@/components/layout/Logo'

function BATAMARTLogo({ appMode = false }: { appMode?: boolean }) {
  const href = appMode ? '/marketplace?app=true' : '/'
  return <Logo href={href} size={30} />
}

function AppTopBar({
  isLoggedIn,
  cartCount,
}: {
  isLoggedIn: boolean
  cartCount: number
}) {
  return (
    <nav className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/92 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between h-14 px-4">
        <BATAMARTLogo appMode />
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {isLoggedIn ? (
            <>
              <Link href="/cart?app=true" className="relative p-2 text-ink-secondary">
                <ShoppingBag className="w-6 h-6" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                {cartCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="absolute top-0.5 right-0.5 bg-primary text-white text-[10px] font-medium w-4 h-4 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center leading-none">
                    {cartCount > 9 ? '9+' : cartCount}
                  </span>
                )}
              </Link>
              <NotificationBell />
            </>
          ) : (
            <Link
              href="/login?app=true"
              className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium text-white bg-primary hover:brightness-95 transition-all"
            >
              Login
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </nav>
  )
}

function RiderTopBar({
  isLoggedIn,
  userName,
}: {
  isLoggedIn: boolean
  userName: string
}) {
  return (
    <nav className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/92 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between h-14 px-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center bg-primary">
            <Bike className="w-4 h-4 text-white" strokeWidth={1.75} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-ink font-semibold text-sm leading-none">BataMart</p>
            <p className="text-primary text-[10px] font-medium leading-none mt-0.5">Rider mode</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {isLoggedIn && userName && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-primary/10 border border-primary/30 flex items-center justify-center text-primary text-xs font-semibold">
              {userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </div>
            <span className="text-ink-secondary text-xs font-medium">{userName.split(' ')[0]}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </nav>
  )
}

function RiderBottomNav({ onLogout }: { onLogout: () => void }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const [profileOpen, setProfileOpen] = useState(false)
  const [isAvailable, setIsAvailable] = useState<boolean | null>(null)
  const [toggling, setToggling] = useState(false)
  const { isKeyboardOpen } = useKeyboardVisibility()

  useEffect(() => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
    if (!token) return
    fetch('/api/auth/me', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { if (d.user) setIsAvailable(d.user.isAvailable ?? true) })
      .catch(() => {})
  }, [])

  const toggleAvailability = async () => {
    if (toggling) return
    setToggling(true)
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
      const res = await fetch('/api/riders/toggle-availability', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
      })
      if (res.ok) setIsAvailable(prev => !prev)
    } catch {}
    finally { setToggling(false) }
  }

  const isActive = (path: string) =>
    pathname === path || pathname.startsWith(path + '/')
  const riderTab = searchParams.get('tab') || ''

  const handleTabPress = (href: string, active: boolean) => (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (active) {
      router.refresh()
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
      return
    }
    router.push(href)
  }

  const leftTabs = [
    {
      href: '/rider-dashboard?app=true&rider=true',
      label: 'Dashboard',
      match: '/rider-dashboard',
      icon: <LayoutGrid className="w-[22px] h-[22px]" strokeWidth={1.75} />,
    },
    {
      href: '/rider-dashboard?app=true&rider=true&tab=deliveries',
      label: 'Deliveries',
      match: '/rider-dashboard',
      icon: <Package className="w-[22px] h-[22px]" strokeWidth={1.75} />,
    },
  ]

  const rightTabs = [
    {
      href: '/wallet?app=true&rider=true',
      label: 'Earnings',
      match: '/wallet',
      icon: <Wallet className="w-[22px] h-[22px]" strokeWidth={1.75} />,
    },
  ]

  return (
    <>
      <nav
        className={`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/92 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border shadow-soft transition-transform transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out ${isKeyboardOpen ? 'translate-y-full opacity-0 pointer-events-none' : 'translate-y-0 opacity-100'}`}
        style={{
          willChange: 'transform',
          backfaceVisibility: 'hidden',
          WebkitBackfaceVisibility: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="flex items-stretch"
          style={{
            height: 'calc(64px + max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 16px))',
            paddingBottom: 'max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 16px)',
          }}
        >
          {leftTabs.map(({ href, label, match, icon }) => {
            const active = label === 'Deliveries'
              ? pathname === '/rider-dashboard' && riderTab === 'deliveries'
              : pathname === '/rider-dashboard' && riderTab !== 'deliveries'
            return (
              <Link
                key={label}
                href={href}
                onClick={handleTabPress(href, active)}
                className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-[3px] relative transition-all duration-200 ease-out active:scale-[0.98] ${
                  active ? 'text-primary' : 'text-ink-muted'
                }`}
              >
                {active && (
                  <span className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-8 h-[3px] rounded-b-full bg-primary" />
                )}
                <span className={active ? 'scale-110 transition-transform' : 'transition-transform'}>
                  {icon}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium leading-none">{label}</span>
              </Link>
            )
          })}

          <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center relative">
            <button
              onClick={toggleAvailability}
              disabled={toggling || isAvailable === null}
              className="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center -mt-5"
            >
              <div
                className={`w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-soft ${
                  isAvailable ? 'bg-success' : 'bg-ink-muted'
                }`}
                style={{ opacity: toggling ? 0.7 : 1 }}
              >
                <Bike className="w-6 h-6 text-white" strokeWidth={1.75} />
              </div>
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-medium mt-1 leading-none ${isAvailable ? 'text-success' : 'text-ink-muted'}`}>
                {isAvailable === null ? '…' : isAvailable ? 'Online' : 'Offline'}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {rightTabs.map(({ href, label, match, icon }) => {
            const active = isActive(match)
            return (
              <Link
                key={label}
                href={href}
                onClick={handleTabPress(href, active)}
                className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-[3px] relative transition-all duration-200 ease-out active:scale-[0.98] ${
                  active ? 'text-primary' : 'text-ink-muted'
                }`}
              >
                {active && (
                  <span className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-8 h-[3px] rounded-b-full bg-primary" />
                )}
                <span className={active ? 'scale-110 transition-transform' : 'transition-transform'}>
                  {icon}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium leading-none">{label}</span>
              </Link>
            )
          })}

          <button
            onClick={() => setProfileOpen(true)}
            className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-[3px] relative transition-all duration-200 ease-out active:scale-[0.98] ${
              profileOpen ? 'text-primary' : 'text-ink-muted'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="w-[26px] h-[26px] rounded-full bg-primary/10 border border-primary/30 flex items-center justify-center">
              <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" strokeWidth={1.75} />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-medium leading-none">Profile</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {profileOpen && (
        <>
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-ink/40"
            onClick={() => setProfileOpen(false)}
          />
          <div
            className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-[70] rounded-t-2xl shadow-soft border-t border-border bg-white"
            style={{
              paddingBottom: 'calc(24px + max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 16px))',
            }}
          >
            <div className="flex justify-center pt-3 pb-2">
              <div className="w-10 h-1 bg-border rounded-full" />
            </div>
            <div className="px-4 py-2">
              {[
                { href: '/rider-dashboard?app=true&rider=true', icon: LayoutGrid, label: 'Dashboard' },
                { href: '/wallet?app=true&rider=true', icon: Wallet, label: 'Earnings' },
                { href: '/notifications?app=true&rider=true', icon: BellIcon, label: 'Notifications' },
              ].map(({ href, icon: Icon, label }) => (
                <Link
                  key={label}
                  href={href}
                  onClick={() => setProfileOpen(false)}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 px-2 py-3.5 text-ink hover:text-primary border-b border-border last:border-0"
                >
                  <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-ink-muted" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                  <span className="font-medium text-sm">{label}</span>
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="px-6 pt-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => { setProfileOpen(false); onLogout() }}
                className="flex items-center justify-center w-full gap-2 bg-danger/10 text-danger font-medium py-3 rounded-lg border border-danger/20"
              >
                <LogOut className="w-5 h-5" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                Logout
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

function AppBottomNav({
  isLoggedIn,
  userRole,
  isSellerMode,
  userName,
  onLogout,
  onToggleMode,
}: {
  isLoggedIn: boolean
  userRole: string
  isSellerMode: boolean
  userName: string
  onLogout: () => void
  onToggleMode: () => void
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const [profileOpen, setProfileOpen] = useState(false)
  const { isKeyboardOpen } = useKeyboardVisibility()

  const isActive = (path: string) =>
    pathname === path || pathname.startsWith(path + '/')

  const handleTabPress = (href: string, active: boolean) => (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (active) {
      router.refresh()
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' })
      return
    }
    router.push(href)
  }

  const isSeller = userRole === 'SELLER' || userRole === 'ADMIN'

  const sellHref = isLoggedIn
    ? isSeller && isSellerMode ? '/sell?app=true' : '/become-seller?app=true'
    : '/login?app=true'

  const leftTabs = [
    {
      href: '/marketplace?app=true',
      label: 'Market',
      match: '/marketplace',
      icon: <Store className="w-[22px] h-[22px]" strokeWidth={1.75} />,
    },
    {
      href: isLoggedIn ? '/orders?app=true' : '/login?app=true',
      label: 'Orders',
      match: '/orders',
      icon: <Package className="w-[22px] h-[22px]" strokeWidth={1.75} />,
    },
  ]

  const rightTabs = [
    {
      href: isLoggedIn ? '/wallet?app=true' : '/login?app=true',
      label: 'Wallet',
      match: '/wallet',
      icon: <Wallet className="w-[22px] h-[22px]" strokeWidth={1.75} />,
    },
  ]

  return (
    <>
      <nav
        className={`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/92 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border shadow-soft transition-transform transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out ${isKeyboardOpen ? 'translate-y-full opacity-0 pointer-events-none' : 'translate-y-0 opacity-100'}`}
        style={{
          willChange: 'transform',
          WebkitBackfaceVisibility: 'hidden',
          backfaceVisibility: 'hidden',
        }}
      >
        <div
          className="flex items-stretch"
          style={{
            height: 'calc(64px + max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 16px))',
            paddingBottom: 'max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 16px)',
          }}
        >
          {leftTabs.map(({ href, label, match, icon }) => {
            const active = isActive(match)
            return (
              <Link
                key={label}
                href={href}
                onClick={handleTabPress(href, active)}
                className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-[3px] relative transition-all duration-200 ease-out active:scale-[0.98] ${
                  active ? 'text-primary' : 'text-ink-muted'
                }`}
              >
                {active && (
                  <span className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-8 h-[3px] bg-primary rounded-b-full" />
                )}
                <span className={active ? 'scale-110 transition-transform' : 'transition-transform'}>
                  {icon}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium leading-none">{label}</span>
              </Link>
            )
          })}

          <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center relative">
            <Link
              href={sellHref}
              onClick={handleTabPress(sellHref, isActive('/sell') || isActive('/become-seller'))}
              className="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center -mt-5"
            >
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center bg-primary shadow-soft transition-transform active:scale-95">
                <Plus className="w-7 h-7 text-white" strokeWidth={1.75} />
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-primary mt-1 leading-none">Sell</span>
            </Link>
          </div>

          {rightTabs.map(({ href, label, match, icon }) => {
            const active = isActive(match)
            return (
              <Link
                key={label}
                href={href}
                onClick={handleTabPress(href, active)}
                className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-[3px] relative transition-all duration-200 ease-out active:scale-[0.98] ${
                  active ? 'text-primary' : 'text-ink-muted'
                }`}
              >
                {active && (
                  <span className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-8 h-[3px] bg-primary rounded-b-full" />
                )}
                <span className={active ? 'scale-110 transition-transform' : 'transition-transform'}>
                  {icon}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-medium leading-none">{label}</span>
              </Link>
            )
          })}

          <button
            onClick={() => setProfileOpen(true)}
            className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-[3px] relative transition-all duration-200 ease-out active:scale-[0.98] ${
              profileOpen ? 'text-primary' : 'text-ink-muted'
            }`}
          >
            <div
              className={`w-[26px] h-[26px] rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                isLoggedIn
                  ? 'bg-primary/10 text-primary border border-primary/30'
                  : 'bg-surface text-ink-muted'
              }`}
            >
              {isLoggedIn && userName
                ? userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()
                : <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5" strokeWidth={1.75} />}
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-medium leading-none">
              {isLoggedIn ? 'Profile' : 'Login'}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </nav>

      {profileOpen && (
        <>
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-ink/40"
            onClick={() => setProfileOpen(false)}
          />
          <div
            className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-[70] bg-white rounded-t-2xl shadow-soft"
            style={{ paddingBottom: 'calc(24px + max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 16px))' }}
          >
            <div className="flex justify-center pt-3 pb-2">
              <div className="w-10 h-1 bg-border rounded-full" />
            </div>

            {isLoggedIn ? (
              <>
                <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-border">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-primary/10 border border-primary/30 flex items-center justify-center text-primary text-lg font-semibold">
                      {userName.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="font-medium text-ink">{userName}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted capitalize">{userRole.toLowerCase()}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="px-4 py-2">
                  {[
                    { href: '/myprofile?app=true', icon: User, label: 'My Account' },
                    { href: '/my-shop?app=true', icon: Store, label: (userRole === 'SELLER' || userRole === 'ADMIN') && isSellerMode ? 'My Shop' : 'My Items' },
                    { href: '/dispute/select-order?app=true', icon: AlertTriangle, label: 'Disputes', hide: userRole === 'RIDER' },
                  ]
                    .filter(item => !item.hide)
                    .map(({ href, icon: Icon, label }) => (
                      <Link
                        key={label}
                        href={href}
                        onClick={() => setProfileOpen(false)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-3 px-2 py-3.5 text-ink hover:text-primary border-b border-border last:border-0"
                      >
                        <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-ink-muted" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                        <span className="font-medium text-sm">{label}</span>
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                </div>

                <div className="px-6 pt-2 space-y-3">
                  {(userRole === 'SELLER' || userRole === 'ADMIN') && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 bg-surface rounded-lg border border-border">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-ink">Mode</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">{isSellerMode ? 'You are selling' : 'You are buying'}</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-xs text-ink-secondary">Buying</span>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => { onToggleMode() }}
                          className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors ${isSellerMode ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-border'}`}
                        >
                          <span
                            className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 transform rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ${
                              isSellerMode ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                            }`}
                          />
                        </button>
                        <span className="text-xs text-ink-secondary">Selling</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <button
                    onClick={() => { setProfileOpen(false); onLogout() }}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center w-full gap-2 bg-danger/10 text-danger font-medium py-3 rounded-lg"
                  >
                    <LogOut className="w-5 h-5" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                    Logout
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="px-6 py-6 flex flex-col gap-3">
                <p className="text-center text-ink-secondary text-sm mb-2">Sign in to access your account</p>
                <Link
                  href="/login?app=true"
                  onClick={() => setProfileOpen(false)}
                  className="text-center h-11 flex items-center justify-center border border-primary text-primary rounded-lg font-medium"
                >
                  Login
                </Link>
                <Link
                  href="/signup?app=true"
                  onClick={() => setProfileOpen(false)}
                  className="text-center h-11 flex items-center justify-center text-white rounded-lg font-medium bg-primary"
                >
                  Create account
                </Link>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

export function Navbar() {
  const router   = useRouter()
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()

  const isAppParam   = searchParams.get('app')     === 'true'
  const isAndroid    = searchParams.get('android') === 'true'
  const isRiderParam = searchParams.get('rider')   === 'true'

  const [isStandalone, setIsStandalone] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)')
    setIsStandalone(mq.matches)
    const handler = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setIsStandalone(e.matches)
    mq.addEventListener('change', handler)
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', handler)
  }, [])

  const isApp = isAppParam || isStandalone

  const [isRider, setIsRider] = useState(false)
  useEffect(() => {
    const onRiderRoute =
      pathname?.startsWith('/rider-dashboard') ||
      pathname?.startsWith('/rider/login')

    if (isRiderParam || onRiderRoute || sessionStorage.getItem('batamart_rider_mode') === 'true') {
      sessionStorage.setItem('batamart_rider_mode', 'true')
      setIsRider(true)
    } else {
      setIsRider(false)
    }
  }, [isRiderParam, pathname])

  const riderRouteAllowed =
    pathname?.startsWith('/rider-dashboard') ||
    pathname?.startsWith('/wallet') ||
    pathname?.startsWith('/notifications') ||
    pathname?.startsWith('/rider/login') ||
    pathname?.startsWith('/login')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isApp || !isRider) return
    if (!riderRouteAllowed) {
      router.replace('/rider-dashboard?app=true&rider=true')
    }
  }, [isApp, isRider, riderRouteAllowed, router])

  const [splashDone, setSplashDone] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return true
    return !isSplashPending()
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    if (splashDone) return
    const handler = () => setSplashDone(true)
    window.addEventListener('batamart:splash-done', handler)
    const fallback = setTimeout(() => setSplashDone(true), 4000)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('batamart:splash-done', handler)
      clearTimeout(fallback)
    }
  }, [splashDone])

  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen]               = useState(false)
  const [isLoggedIn, setIsLoggedIn]               = useState(false)
  const [userName, setUserName]                   = useState('')
  const [userBalance, setUserBalance]             = useState(0)
  const [userRole, setUserRole]                   = useState('')
  const [isSellerMode, setIsSellerMode]           = useState(true)
  const [isUserDropdownOpen, setIsUserDropdownOpen] = useState(false)
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible]                 = useState(true)
  const lastScrollY  = useRef(0)
  const dropdownRef  = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  const getTotalItems = useCartStore((state) => state.getTotalItems)
  const cartCount = getTotalItems()

  useEffect(() => {
    const isIOS = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) && !(window as any).MSStream
    if (isIOS && isApp) return

    const handleScroll = () => {
      const currentScrollY = window.scrollY
      if (currentScrollY > lastScrollY.current && currentScrollY > 80) {
        setIsVisible(false)
      } else {
        setIsVisible(true)
      }
      lastScrollY.current = currentScrollY
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll)
  }, [isApp])

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsUserDropdownOpen(false)
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkAuth = async () => {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
      if (token) {
        setIsLoggedIn(true)
        const storedName = localStorage.getItem('userName')
        if (storedName) setUserName(storedName)
        const sellerModePref = localStorage.getItem('sellerMode')
        if (sellerModePref !== null) setIsSellerMode(sellerModePref === 'true')
        try {
          const response = await fetch('/api/auth/me', {
            headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
          })
          const data = await response.json()
          if (response.ok && data.user) {
            setUserName(data.user.name)
            setUserBalance(data.user.availableBalance || 0)
            setUserRole(data.user.role || 'BUYER')
            localStorage.setItem('userName', data.user.name)
            if (data.user.isSellerMode !== undefined) {
              setIsSellerMode(data.user.isSellerMode)
              localStorage.setItem('sellerMode', data.user.isSellerMode.toString())
            }
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching user details:', error)
        }
      } else {
        setIsLoggedIn(false)
        setUserName('')
        setUserBalance(0)
        setUserRole('')
        setIsSellerMode(true)
      }
    }
    checkAuth()
    window.addEventListener('auth-change', checkAuth)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('auth-change', checkAuth)
  }, [pathname])

  const toggleRoleMode = async () => {
    const newMode = !isSellerMode
    setIsSellerMode(newMode)
    localStorage.setItem('sellerMode', newMode.toString())
    if (userRole === 'SELLER' || userRole === 'ADMIN') {
      try {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('token')
        await fetch('/api/auth/toggle-seller-mode', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
          body: JSON.stringify({ isSellerMode: newMode }),
        })
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error updating seller mode:', error)
      }
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('auth-change'))
  }

  // ── FIXED: clear cookie on logout + send riders to /rider/login ──────────
  const handleLogout = () => {
    localStorage.clear()
    document.cookie = 'token=; path=/; max-age=0'          // ← clears the cookie middleware reads
    sessionStorage.removeItem('batamart_rider_mode')
    setIsLoggedIn(false)
    setUserName('')
    setUserBalance(0)
    setUserRole('')
    setIsSellerMode(true)
    setIsUserDropdownOpen(false)
    router.push(isRider ? '/rider/login' : isApp ? '/marketplace?app=true' : '/')  // ← riders go to /rider/login
  }

  const isActive = (path: string) => pathname === path || pathname.startsWith(path + '/')

  if (isAndroid) return null
  if (!splashDone) return null
  if (pathname === '/' || pathname?.startsWith('/rider/login')) return null

  if (isApp) {
    if (isRider) {
      return (
        <>
          <RiderTopBar isLoggedIn={isLoggedIn} userName={userName} />
          <RiderBottomNav onLogout={handleLogout} />
        </>
      )
    }
    return (
      <>
        <AppTopBar isLoggedIn={isLoggedIn} cartCount={cartCount} />
        <AppBottomNav
          isLoggedIn={isLoggedIn}
          userRole={userRole}
          isSellerMode={isSellerMode}
          userName={userName}
          onLogout={handleLogout}
          onToggleMode={toggleRoleMode}
        />
      </>
    )
  }

  return (
    <nav
      className={`fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border shadow-soft transition-transform duration-300 ${
        isVisible ? 'translate-y-0' : '-translate-y-full'
      }`}
    >
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between h-16">

          <Logo size={34} />

          <div className="hidden md:flex items-center space-x-2">
            {isLoggedIn && (
              <Link href="/cart" className="relative p-2 text-ink-secondary hover:text-primary hover:bg-surface rounded-full transition-all">
                <ShoppingBag className="w-6 h-6" strokeWidth={1.75} />
                {cartCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="absolute top-0 right-0 bg-primary text-white text-xs font-medium w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center">
                    {cartCount > 9 ? '9+' : cartCount}
                  </span>
                )}
              </Link>
            )}
            {isLoggedIn && <NotificationBell />}
            {isLoggedIn ? (
              <div className="relative ml-2" ref={dropdownRef}>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsUserDropdownOpen(!isUserDropdownOpen)}
