import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'

const prisma = new PrismaClient()

const PRESERVE_TABLES = new Set([
  'University',
  'User',
  'Product',
  'ProductVariant',
  'ProductAttributeValue',
  'CategoryAttribute',
  'AttributeSuggestion',
  'AttributeValueStats',
])

async function main() {
  if (!process.argv.includes('--confirm')) {
    console.error('Refusing to run without --confirm')
    process.exit(1)
  }

  const preserveList = Array.from(PRESERVE_TABLES)
    .map(name => `'${name.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`)
    .join(', ')

  const tables = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe<Array<{ schemaname: string; tablename: string }>>(
    `SELECT schemaname, tablename
     FROM pg_tables
     WHERE schemaname = 'public'
       AND tablename NOT IN (${preserveList})
     ORDER BY tablename`
  )

  const tableNames = tables.map(t => `${t.schemaname}.${t.tablename}`)

  if (tableNames.length === 0) {
    console.log('Nothing to purge.')
    return
  }

  console.log('Purging tables:')
  for (const name of tableNames) {
    console.log(`- ${name}`)
  }

  const quotedTables = tables
    .map(t => `"${t.schemaname}"."${t.tablename.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`)
    .join(', ')

  await prisma.$executeRawUnsafe(`TRUNCATE TABLE ${quotedTables} RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE`)

  console.log('Cleanup complete. Core product and user tables were preserved.')
}

main()
  .catch(error => {
    console.error('Database purge failed:', error)
    process.exit(1)
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect()
  })
scripts/simulate-query.ts
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
import { getCategoryQueryValues } from '../lib/variants'

const prisma = new PrismaClient()

async function test(requestedCategoryKey: string) {
  // Simulate what backend does:
  // resolveCategoryKey
  const CATEGORY_TREE: any = {
    electronics: { label: 'Electronics' },
    computing: { label: 'Computing' },
    fashion: { label: 'Fashion' },
    home_kitchen: { label: 'Home & Kitchen' },
    groceries: { label: 'Food & Groceries' },
    beauty: { label: 'Beauty & Health' },
    sports: { label: 'Sports & Fitness' },
    vehicles: { label: 'Vehicles & Transport' },
    books: { label: 'Books & Stationery' },
    tickets: { label: 'Tickets & Events' },
    kids: { label: 'Kids & Baby' },
    arts_crafts: { label: 'Arts & Crafts' },
  }

  function resolveCategoryKeyLocal(input: string) {
    const value = input?.trim()
    if (!value) return ''
    if (CATEGORY_TREE[value]) return value
    const normalized = value.toLowerCase()
    const match = Object.entries(CATEGORY_TREE).find(([key, category]: any) => {
      return key.toLowerCase() === normalized || category.label.toLowerCase() === normalized
    })
    return match?.[0] || ''
  }

  const categoryKey = resolveCategoryKeyLocal(requestedCategoryKey)
  console.log(`\nSimulating for input: "${requestedCategoryKey}" -> resolved categoryKey: "${categoryKey}"`)

  const categoryValues = getCategoryQueryValues(requestedCategoryKey || CATEGORY_TREE[categoryKey]?.label || '')
  console.log('categoryValues for query:', categoryValues)

  const where: any = {
    isActive: true,
    isDeleted: false,
    moderationStatus: 'APPROVED',
  }

  if (categoryKey && categoryKey !== 'all') {
    where.AND = [
      {
        OR: [
          { categoryKey: categoryKey },
          ...(categoryValues.length > 0 ? categoryValues.map((value) => ({ category: { equals: value } })) : []),
        ],
      },
    ]
  }

  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where,
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      category: true,
      categoryKey: true,
    },
  })

  console.log(`Matched ${products.length} products.`)
  if (products.length > 0) {
    console.log('Sample matches (up to 5):')
    console.log(products.slice(0, 5))
  }
}

async function main() {
  await test('beauty')
  await test('Beauty & Health')
  await test('Beauty & Personal Care')
  await test('Food & Groceries')
}

main()
  .catch(console.error)
  .finally(() => prisma.$disconnect())
scripts/zero-wallet-balances.ts
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'

const prisma = new PrismaClient()

async function main() {
  if (!process.argv.includes('--confirm')) {
    console.error('Refusing to run without --confirm')
    process.exit(1)
  }

  const result = await prisma.user.updateMany({
    data: {
      availableBalance: 0,
      pendingBalance: 0,
    },
  })

  console.log(`Reset wallet balances for ${result.count} user(s).`)
}

main()
  .catch(error => {
    console.error('Wallet reset failed:', error)
    process.exit(1)
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect()
  })
prisma/schema.prisma
generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = ["multiSchema"]
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("POOLED_DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
  schemas   = ["public"]
}

model University {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String    @unique
  shortName     String    @unique
  slug          String    @unique
  location      String
  isActive      Boolean   @default(true)
  deliveryAreas Json      @default("[]")
  hostels       Json      @default("[]")
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
  products      Product[]
  users         User[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@schema("public")
}

model User {
  id                       String              @id @default(cuid())
  phone                    String              @unique
  email                    String?             @unique
  password                 String
  matricNumber             String?             @unique
  name                     String
  profilePhoto             String?
  role                     UserRole            @default(BUYER)
  isSellerMode             Boolean             @default(true)
  hostelName               String?
  roomNumber               String?
  landmark                 String?
  bio                      String?
  trustLevel               TrustLevel          @default(BRONZE)
  avgRating                Float               @default(0)
  totalReviews             Int                 @default(0)
  completedOrders          Int                 @default(0)
  penaltyPoints            Int                 @default(0)
  isSuspended              Boolean             @default(false)
  suspendedUntil           DateTime?
  warningCount             Int                 @default(0)
  lastWarningAt            DateTime?
  pendingBalance           Decimal             @default(0) @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  availableBalance         Decimal             @default(0) @db.Decimal(12, 2)
  isRiderVerified          Boolean             @default(false)
  riderIdDocument          String?
  isAvailable              Boolean             @default(true)
  createdAt                DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt                DateTime            @updatedAt
  suspensionReason         String?
  deletedAt                DateTime?
  isDeleted                Boolean             @default(false)
  referralCode             String              @unique
  referredById             String?
  withdrawalPin            String?
  withdrawalPinAttempts    Int                 @default(0)
  withdrawalPinLockedUntil DateTime?
  universityId             String?
  auditLogs                AuditLog[]
  cart                     Cart?
  buyerBatches             DeliveryBatch[]     @relation("BuyerBatches")
  riderBatches             DeliveryBatch[]     @relation("RiderBatches")
  disputesAsBuyer          Dispute[]           @relation("BuyerDisputes")
  resolvedDisputes         Dispute[]           @relation("ResolvedBy")
  disputesAsSeller         Dispute[]           @relation("SellerDisputes")
  notifications            Notification[]
  orders                   Order[]             @relation("BuyerOrders")
  riderDeliveries          Order[]             @relation("RiderDeliveries")
  sellerOrders             Order[]             @relation("SellerOrders")
  issuedPenalties          Penalty[]           @relation("IssuedBy")
  penaltiesReceived        Penalty[]           @relation("UserPenalties")
  products                 Product[]
  productReports           ProductReport[]
  productReviewsGiven      ProductReview[]     @relation("ProductReviewsGiven")
  pushSubscriptions        PushSubscription[]
  referralRewardsGenerated ReferralReward[]    @relation("ReferredUserRewards")
  referralRewardsEarned    ReferralReward[]    @relation("ReferrerRewards")
  reportsReceived          Report[]            @relation("ReportsReceived")
  reportsSubmitted         Report[]            @relation("ReportsSubmitted")
  resolvedReports          Report[]            @relation("ResolvedBy")
  reviewsReceived          Review[]            @relation("UserReviewsReceived")
  reviewsGiven             Review[]            @relation("UserReviewsGiven")
  sellerStrikes            SellerStrike[]
  supportTickets           SupportTicket[]
  transactions             Transaction[]
  referredBy               User?               @relation("UserReferrals", fields: [referredById], references: [id])
  referrals                User[]              @relation("UserReferrals")
  university               University?         @relation(fields: [universityId], references: [id])
  withdrawalRequests       WithdrawalRequest[]

  @@index([role])
  @@index([trustLevel])
  @@index([isSuspended])
  @@index([isDeleted])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([referralCode])
  @@index([universityId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model DeliveryBatch {
  id               String      @id @default(cuid())
  batchNumber      String      @unique
  buyerId          String
  riderId          String?
  universityId     String
  paymentReference String?
  referralPaid     Boolean     @default(false)
  status           BatchStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt        DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime    @updatedAt
  buyer            User        @relation("BuyerBatches", fields: [buyerId], references: [id])
  rider            User?       @relation("RiderBatches", fields: [riderId], references: [id])
  orders           Order[]

  @@index([buyerId])
  @@index([riderId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([universityId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Product {
  id                       String                  @id @default(cuid())
  name                     String
  description              String
  price                    Float
  basePrice                Float?
  images                   String[]
  category                 String
  categoryKey              String?
  quantity                 Int                     @default(1)
  hostelName               String
  roomNumber               String
  landmark                 String
  sellerId                 String
  isActive                 Boolean                 @default(true)
  viewCount                Int                     @default(0)
  avgRating                Float                   @default(0)
  totalReviews             Int                     @default(0)
  createdAt                DateTime                @default(now())
  updatedAt                DateTime                @updatedAt
  deletedAt                DateTime?
  isDeleted                Boolean                 @default(false)
  productDeliveryAgreement Boolean                 @default(false)
  deliveryEstimate         String?
  moderationStatus         ProductModerationStatus @default(PENDING)
  rejectionReason          String?
  estimatedWeightKg        Float?
  dimensionsCm             Json?
  universityId             String?
  subcategory              String?
  subcategoryKey           String?
  variantsEnabled          Boolean                 @default(false)
  marketPrice              Float? // Last confirmed campus sale price for this product type
  discountPercent          Int? // % cheaper than last confirmed sale price; null = not a deal
  isDeal                   Boolean                 @default(false)
  nameKey                  String? // normalised product name for market price matching
  variantKey               String? // price-sensitive variant fingerprint (model/storage/ram/etc)
  conditionType            String? // "NEW" | "USED" | "REFURBISHED"
  hasChangedParts          Boolean                 @default(false)
  isHot                    Boolean                 @default(false)
  hotReason                String? // "VIEWS" | "DEAL" | "BOTH"
  hotScore                 Int                     @default(0)
  isFlagged                Boolean                 @default(false)
  flagReason               String?
  cartItems                CartItem[]
  variants                 ProductVariant[]
  attributeValues          ProductAttributeValue[]
  orderItems               OrderItem[]
  orders                   Order[]
  seller                   User                    @relation(fields: [sellerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  university               University?             @relation(fields: [universityId], references: [id])
  reviews                  ProductReview[]
  reports                  Report[]
  productReports           ProductReport[]

  @@index([sellerId])
  @@index([category])
  @@index([subcategory])
  @@index([categoryKey])
  @@index([subcategoryKey])
  @@index([variantsEnabled])
  @@index([isActive])
  @@index([isDeleted])
  @@index([moderationStatus])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([universityId])
  @@index([nameKey])
  @@index([variantKey])
  @@index([isHot])
  @@index([isFlagged])
  @@index([conditionType])
  @@index([nameKey, conditionType, hasChangedParts, variantKey])
  @@index([universityId, isActive, isDeleted, quantity])
  @@index([isHot, universityId])
  @@index([moderationStatus, createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model ProductReport {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  productId String
  reason    String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  product   Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, productId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model CategoryAttribute {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  categoryKey    String
  subcategoryKey String?
  key            String
  label          String
  type           String
  options        Json?
  required       Boolean  @default(false)
  filterable     Boolean  @default(true)
  searchable     Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([categoryKey, subcategoryKey, key])
  @@index([categoryKey])
  @@index([subcategoryKey])
  @@schema("public")
}

model ProductAttributeValue {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  productId  String
  product    Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  key        String
  label      String
  value      Json
  searchable Boolean  @default(true)
  filterable Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([productId])
  @@index([key])
  @@schema("public")
}

model AttributeSuggestion {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  categoryKey    String
  subcategoryKey String?
  key            String
  label          String
  occurrences    Int      @default(1)
  approved       Boolean  @default(false)
  autoPromoted   Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([categoryKey, subcategoryKey, key])
  @@index([categoryKey])
  @@index([subcategoryKey])
  @@schema("public")
}

model AttributeValueStats {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  categoryKey String
  key         String
  value       String
  count       Int      @default(1)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([categoryKey, key, value])
  @@index([categoryKey])
  @@index([key])
  @@schema("public")
}

model ProductParseCache {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  rawText    String   @unique
  parsedData Json
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@schema("public")
}

model ProductCoView {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  productId        String
  relatedProductId String
  count            Int      @default(1)
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([productId, relatedProductId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model UserSessionEvent {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String?
  sessionId String
  productId String?
  eventType String
  meta      Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([sessionId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model ProductVariant {
  id          String      @id @default(cuid())
  productId   String
  product     Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  combination Json
  price       Float
  stock       Int         @default(0)
  sku         String?
  imageUrl    String?
  createdAt   DateTime    @default(now())
  orderItems  OrderItem[]

  @@index([productId])
  @@index([stock])
  @@schema("public")
}

model MarketPrice {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  nameKey         String
  variantKey      String?
  category        String
  condition       String
  hasChangedParts Boolean  @default(false)
  confirmedPrice  Float
  productId       String
  orderId         String   @unique
  recordedAt      DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([nameKey, condition, hasChangedParts])
  @@index([nameKey, condition, hasChangedParts, variantKey])
  @@index([category])
  @@index([recordedAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Order {
  id                          String          @id @default(cuid())
  orderNumber                 String          @unique
  buyerId                     String
  sellerId                    String
  productId                   String
  riderId                     String?
  productPrice                Float
  deliveryFee                 Float
  totalAmount                 Float
  platformCommission          Float           @default(0)
  quantity                    Int             @default(1)
  deliveryHostel              String
  deliveryRoom                String
  deliveryLandmark            String
  deliveryPhone               String
  status                      OrderStatus     @default(PENDING)
  orderedAt                   DateTime        @default(now())
  riderAssignedAt             DateTime?
  pickedUpAt                  DateTime?
  deliveredAt                 DateTime?
  completedAt                 DateTime?
  isPaid                      Boolean         @default(false)
  isDisputed                  Boolean         @default(false)
  disputeReason               String?
  createdAt                   DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt                   DateTime        @updatedAt
  orderNote                   String?
  buyerDeliveryAcknowledged   Boolean         @default(false)
  oversizedCancellationReason String?
  batchId                     String?
  dispute                     Dispute?
  batch                       DeliveryBatch?  @relation(fields: [batchId], references: [id])
  buyer                       User            @relation("BuyerOrders", fields: [buyerId], references: [id])
  product                     Product         @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  rider                       User?           @relation("RiderDeliveries", fields: [riderId], references: [id])
  seller                      User            @relation("SellerOrders", fields: [sellerId], references: [id])
  payment                     Payment?
  productReviews              ProductReview[]
  referralReward              ReferralReward?
  reports                     Report[]
  reviews                     Review[]
  items                       OrderItem[]

  @@index([buyerId])
  @@index([sellerId])
  @@index([riderId])
  @@index([batchId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([orderedAt])
  @@index([buyerId, status])
  @@index([sellerId, status])
  @@index([riderId, status])
  @@schema("public")
}

model OrderItem {
  id          String          @id @default(cuid())
  orderId     String
  order       Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  productId   String
  product     Product         @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variantId   String?
  variant     ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  variantData Json?
  quantity    Int
  price       Float
  createdAt   DateTime        @default(now())

  @@index([orderId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@index([variantId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Review {
  id         String     @id @default(cuid())
  rating     Int
  comment    String?
  orderId    String
  reviewerId String
  revieweeId String
  type       ReviewType @default(SELLER)
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime   @updatedAt
  order      Order      @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  reviewee   User       @relation("UserReviewsReceived", fields: [revieweeId], references: [id])
  reviewer   User       @relation("UserReviewsGiven", fields: [reviewerId], references: [id])

  @@unique([orderId, type, reviewerId])
  @@index([orderId])
  @@index([revieweeId])
  @@index([reviewerId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model ProductReview {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  rating     Int
  comment    String
  orderId    String
  productId  String
  reviewerId String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt
  order      Order    @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product    Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  reviewer   User     @relation("ProductReviewsGiven", fields: [reviewerId], references: [id])

  @@unique([orderId, productId, reviewerId])
  @@index([orderId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@index([reviewerId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model SearchLog {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String?
  universityId String?
  query       String
  category    String?
  resultCount Int      @default(0)
  clickedId   String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([universityId, createdAt])
  @@index([query])
  @@schema("public")
}

model AppSetting {
  key       String   @id
  value     Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@schema("public")
}

model OTP {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  phone     String?
  email     String?
  code      String
  expiresAt DateTime
  isUsed    Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([phone])
  @@index([email])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Payment {
  id              String        @id @default(cuid())
  orderId         String        @unique
  amount          Float
  method          PaymentMethod
  status          PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  transactionId   String?       @unique
  gatewayResponse Json?
  paidAt          DateTime?
  refundedAt      DateTime?
  refundAmount    Float?
  refundReason    String?
  createdAt       DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime      @updatedAt
  order           Order         @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([orderId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([transactionId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Transaction {
  id            String          @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String
  type          TransactionType
  amount        Float
  description   String
  reference     String?
  balanceBefore Float
  balanceAfter  Float
  createdAt     DateTime        @default(now())
  user          User            @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model WithdrawalRequest {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  userId          String
  clientRequestId String?          @unique
  amount          Float
  bankDetails     Json
  status          WithdrawalStatus @default(PENDING)
  adminNotes      String?
  processedAt     DateTime?
  processedBy     String?
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt
  user            User             @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Report {
  id                String       @id @default(cuid())
  type              ReportType
  reason            ReportReason
  description       String
  evidence          String[]
  reporterId        String
  reportedUserId    String?
  reportedProductId String?
  reportedOrderId   String?
  status            ReportStatus @default(PENDING)
  adminNotes        String?
  resolvedAt        DateTime?
  resolvedBy        String?
  disputeId         String?      @unique
  createdAt         DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime     @updatedAt
  dispute           Dispute?     @relation(fields: [disputeId], references: [id])
  reportedOrder     Order?       @relation(fields: [reportedOrderId], references: [id])
  reportedProduct   Product?     @relation(fields: [reportedProductId], references: [id])
  reportedUser      User?        @relation("ReportsReceived", fields: [reportedUserId], references: [id])
  reporter          User         @relation("ReportsSubmitted", fields: [reporterId], references: [id])
  resolver          User?        @relation("ResolvedBy", fields: [resolvedBy], references: [id])

  @@index([reporterId])
  @@index([reportedUserId])
  @@index([reportedProductId])
  @@index([status])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Dispute {
  id                   String           @id @default(cuid())
  orderId              String           @unique
  buyerId              String
  sellerId             String
  reason               String
  buyerEvidence        String[]
  sellerEvidence       String[]
  status               DisputeStatus    @default(OPEN)
  resolution           String?
  refundAmount         Float?
  resolvedAt           DateTime?
  resolvedBy           String?
  createdAt            DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime         @updatedAt
  pickupAddress        Json?
  resolutionPreference String?
  buyer                User             @relation("BuyerDisputes", fields: [buyerId], references: [id])
  order                Order            @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id])
  resolver             User?            @relation("ResolvedBy", fields: [resolvedBy], references: [id])
  seller               User             @relation("SellerDisputes", fields: [sellerId], references: [id])
  messages             DisputeMessage[]
  report               Report?

  @@index([orderId])
  @@index([buyerId])
  @@index([sellerId])
  @@index([status])
  @@schema("public")
}

model DisputeMessage {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  disputeId   String
  senderId    String
  senderType  String
  message     String
  attachments String[]
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  dispute     Dispute  @relation(fields: [disputeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([disputeId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Penalty {
  id          String        @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  action      PenaltyAction
  reason      String
  pointsAdded Int
  reportId    String?
  disputeId   String?
  bannedUntil DateTime?
  issuedBy    String?
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now())
  issuer      User?         @relation("IssuedBy", fields: [issuedBy], references: [id])
  user        User          @relation("UserPenalties", fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Notification {
  id               String           @id @default(cuid())
  userId           String
  type             NotificationType
  title            String
  message          String
  orderId          String?
  productId        String?
  disputeId        String?
  reportId         String?
  reviewId         String?
  metadata         Json?
  isRead           Boolean          @default(false)
  readAt           DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime         @default(now())
  referralRewardId String?
  user             User             @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([isRead])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([userId, isRead, createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model PushSubscription {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  endpoint  String   @unique
  p256dh    String
  auth      String
  userId    String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model SupportTicket {
  id         String                @id @default(cuid())
  name       String
  email      String
  message    String
  category   SupportTicketCategory @default(OTHER)
  userId     String?
  status     SupportTicketStatus   @default(OPEN)
  adminNotes String?
  resolvedAt DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime              @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime              @updatedAt
  user       User?                 @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model Cart {
  id        String     @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String     @unique
  updatedAt DateTime   @updatedAt
  user      User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items     CartItem[]

  @@index([userId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model CartItem {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  cartId    String
  productId String
  quantity  Int      @default(1)
  addedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  cart      Cart     @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product   Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([cartId, productId])
  @@index([cartId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@schema("public")
}

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String?
  action     String
  entityType String
  entityId   String
  oldValue   Json?
  newValue   Json?
  ipAddress  String?
  userAgent  String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  user       User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([entityType, entityId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([action])
  @@schema("public")
}

model ReferralReward {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  referrerId     String
  referredUserId String
  orderId        String   @unique
  amount         Float
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  order          Order    @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id])
  referredUser   User     @relation("ReferredUserRewards", fields: [referredUserId], references: [id])
  referrer       User     @relation("ReferrerRewards", fields: [referrerId], references: [id])

  @@index([referrerId])
  @@index([referredUserId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model SellerStrike {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  sellerId         String
  productId        String?
  orderId          String?
  strikeCount      Int
  reason           String
  suspensionReason String?
  suspensionExpiry DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  seller           User      @relation(fields: [sellerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([sellerId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

model OversizedDeclineLog {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  orderId         String
  productId       String
  sellerId        String
  riderId         String
  buyerId         String
  reason          String
  proofImageUrl   String?
  refundIssued    Boolean  @default(false)
  refundAmount    Float?
  deliveryFeeKept Float    @default(0)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([orderId, riderId])
  @@index([sellerId])
  @@index([productId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@schema("public")
}

/* Add these to your global CSS file (globals.css or similar) */

@keyframes slide-in {
  from {
    transform: translateX(100%);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.animate-slide-in {
  animation: slide-in 0.3s ease-out;
}
styles/globals.css
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

/* ── SPLASH BLOCKER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   When splash-pending is on <html>, hide EVERYTHING instantly.
   Uses visibility:hidden so the page still loads in background.
   The inline script in layout.tsx adds this class synchronously,
   BEFORE React hydrates — so nothing shows until SplashScreen removes it.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
html.splash-pending body {
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

html.splash-pending body > * {
  visibility: hidden !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

/* The splash screen itself must always stay visible */
html.splash-pending #__splash_screen {
  visibility: visible !important;
  pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Extra safety: hide the Next.js root div children too */
html.splash-pending body > div > * {
  visibility: hidden !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
}

@layer base {
  :root {
    /* BataMart Design Bible tokens — see BATAMART_DESIGN_BIBLE.md section 2 */
    --color-primary: #1E90FF;
    --color-background: #FFFFFF;
    --color-surface: #F8FAFC;
    --color-border: #E5E7EB;
    --color-text-primary: #111827;
    --color-text-secondary: #6B7280;
    --color-text-muted: #9CA3AF;
    --color-success: #22C55E;
    --color-danger: #EF4444;
    --color-warning: #F59E0B;

    /* Legacy aliases kept for CSS still referencing the old var names below */
    --primary: var(--color-primary);
    --background: var(--color-background);
    --surface: var(--color-surface);
    --text: var(--color-text-primary);
    --muted: var(--color-text-muted);
    --border: var(--color-border);
    --surface-elevated: var(--color-surface);
  }

  .dark {
    --color-primary: #4DABFF;
    --color-background: #000000;
    --color-surface: #0f1115;
    --color-border: #272b33;
    --color-text-primary: #e5e7eb;
    --color-text-secondary: #98a2b3;
    --color-text-muted: #72819a;
    --color-success: #22C55E;
    --color-danger: #EF4444;
    --color-warning: #F59E0B;

    --primary: var(--color-primary);
    --background: var(--color-background);
    --surface: var(--color-surface);
    --text: var(--color-text-primary);
    --muted: var(--color-text-secondary);
    --border: var(--color-border);
    --surface-elevated: #151922;
  }

  /* Global utility remap so existing light-tailwind pages render cleanly in dark mode */
  .dark .bg-white { background-color: var(--surface) !important; }
  .dark .bg-black { background-color: var(--surface) !important; }
  .dark .bg-gray-50 { background-color: var(--surface) !important; }
  .dark .bg-gray-100 { background-color: var(--surface-elevated) !important; }
  .dark .bg-gray-200 { background-color: #1d212b !important; }
  .dark .bg-light-surface { background-color: var(--background) !important; }
  .dark .bg-\[\#fff\],
  .dark .bg-\[\#ffffff\] { background-color: var(--surface) !important; }
  .dark .bg-blue-50 { background-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.16) !important; }
  .dark .bg-indigo-50 { background-color: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) !important; }
  .dark .bg-emerald-50 { background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.16) !important; }
  .dark .bg-violet-50 { background-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.18) !important; }
  .dark .bg-amber-50 { background-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.16) !important; }
  .dark .bg-red-50 { background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.16) !important; }
  .dark .bg-\[\#f0f2f5\],
  .dark .bg-\[\#f7f8fa\] { background-color: var(--background) !important; }
  .dark .bg-\[\#000\],
  .dark .bg-\[\#000000\] { background-color: var(--surface) !important; }
  .dark .bg-\[\#e7ebf2\] { background-color: #0b0d12 !important; }
  .dark .bg-white\/95 { background-color: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.95) !important; }
  .dark .bg-white\/92 { background-color: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.92) !important; }
  .dark .bg-white\/90 { background-color: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.9) !important; }
  .dark .bg-white\/88 { background-color: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.88) !important; }
  .dark .bg-white\/80 { background-color: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.8) !important; }
  .dark .bg-white\/70 { background-color: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.7) !important; }
  .dark .bg-white\/60 { background-color: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.6) !important; }

  .dark .text-gray-900 { color: #e5e7eb !important; }
  .dark .text-gray-800 { color: #d1d5db !important; }
  .dark .text-gray-700 { color: #cbd5e1 !important; }
  .dark .text-gray-600 { color: #9ca3af !important; }
  .dark .text-gray-500 { color: var(--muted) !important; }
  .dark .text-gray-400 { color: #7c8aa3 !important; }
  .dark .text-\[\#1e3a5f\] { color: #9fb7d9 !important; }
  .dark .placeholder\:text-gray-400::placeholder { color: #72819a !important; }

  .dark .border-gray-50,
  .dark .border-gray-100,
  .dark .border-gray-200,
  .dark .border-gray-300,
  .dark .border-gray-600,
  .dark .border-gray-700,
  .dark .border-gray-800 { border-color: var(--border) !important; }
  .dark .border-white,
  .dark .border-white\/90,
  .dark .border-white\/80,
  .dark .border-white\/70,
  .dark .border-white\/60,
  .dark .border-white\/50,
  .dark .border-white\/40,
  .dark .border-white\/30,
  .dark .border-white\/20,
  .dark .border-white\/10 { border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.6) !important; }
  .dark .divide-white > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]),
  .dark .divide-white\/80 > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]),
  .dark .divide-white\/60 > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]),
  .dark .divide-white\/40 > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]),
  .dark .divide-white\/20 > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]),
  .dark .divide-white\/10 > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]) {
    border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.6) !important;
  }
  .dark .ring-white,
  .dark .ring-white\/80,
  .dark .ring-white\/60,
  .dark .ring-white\/40,
  .dark .ring-white\/30,
  .dark .ring-white\/20 { --tw-ring-color: rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.55) !important; }

  .dark .hover\:bg-gray-50:hover { background-color: #141821 !important; }
  .dark .hover\:bg-gray-100:hover { background-color: #1a1f2a !important; }
  .dark .hover\:bg-blue-50:hover { background-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.22) !important; }
  .dark .hover\:text-gray-900:hover { color: #EAEAEA !important; }

  .dark .text-blue-600,
  .dark .text-blue-500,
  .dark .text-indigo-300,
  .dark .text-indigo-400,
  .dark .text-indigo-500,
  .dark .text-primary {
    color: var(--color-primary) !important;
  }

  .dark .from-gray-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #111827 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(17 24 39 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-violet-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #1e1b4b var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(30 27 75 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-indigo-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: var(--surface) var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(30 41 59 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-pink-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #3b0824 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(59 8 36 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-rose-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #3f172a var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(63 23 42 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-sky-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #082f49 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(8 47 73 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-blue-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #172554 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(23 37 84 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-orange-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #431407 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(67 20 7 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-amber-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #451a03 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(69 26 3 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-emerald-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #022c22 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(2 44 34 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-green-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #052e16 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(5 46 22 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .from-fuchsia-50 {
    --tw-gradient-from: #3b0764 var(--tw-gradient-from-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-to: rgb(59 7 100 / 0) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important;
    --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important;
  }
  .dark .to-white { --tw-gradient-to: var(--surface) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important; }
  .dark .to-indigo-50 { --tw-gradient-to: var(--surface) var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important; }
  .dark .to-rose-50 { --tw-gradient-to: #3f172a var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important; }
  .dark .to-blue-50 { --tw-gradient-to: #172554 var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important; }
  .dark .to-amber-50 { --tw-gradient-to: #451a03 var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important; }
  .dark .to-green-50 { --tw-gradient-to: #052e16 var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important; }
  .dark .to-pink-50 { --tw-gradient-to: #3b0824 var(--tw-gradient-to-position) !important; }
  .dark .via-white { --tw-gradient-stops: var(--tw-gradient-from), var(--surface) var(--tw-gradient-via-position), var(--tw-gradient-to) !important; }

  .dark .shadow-sm,
  .dark .shadow,
  .dark .shadow-md,
  .dark .shadow-lg,
  .dark .shadow-xl,
  .dark .shadow-2xl {
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.38) !important;
  }

  .dark [style*="background: #fff"],
  .dark [style*="background:#fff"],
  .dark [style*="background: #ffffff"],
  .dark [style*="background:#ffffff"] {
    background: var(--surface) !important;
  }

  .dark [style*="background:#000"],
  .dark [style*="background: #000"],
  .dark [style*="background:#000000"],
  .dark [style*="background: #000000"] {
    background: var(--surface) !important;
  }

  .dark [style*="border: 1px solid #fff"],
  .dark [style*="border:1px solid #fff"],
  .dark [style*="border: 1px solid #ffffff"],
  .dark [style*="border:1px solid #ffffff"],
  .dark [style*="border-color:#fff"],
  .dark [style*="border-color: #fff"],
  .dark [style*="border-color:#ffffff"],
  .dark [style*="border-color: #ffffff"] {
    border-color: rgba(71, 85, 105, 0.6) !important;
  }

  * {
    @apply border-border;
  }

  body {
    background-color: var(--color-background);
    color: var(--color-text-primary);
    font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
    /* Prevent WebView momentum scroll from dragging fixed elements */
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: none;
  }
}

@layer components {
  /* Design bible section 8 — canonical flat component classes. Prefer the
     components/ui/* React components; these exist for the few places that
     still need a plain CSS class (e.g. server-rendered strings). */
  .btn-primary {
    @apply h-11 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium bg-primary text-white transition-all duration-150 ease-out hover:brightness-95 active:scale-[0.98] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none;
  }

  .btn-secondary {
    @apply h-11 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium bg-white text-ink border border-border transition-all duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-surface active:scale-[0.98] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none;
  }

  .btn-outline {
    @apply h-11 px-6 rounded-lg font-medium border border-primary text-primary bg-transparent transition-all duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-primary hover:text-white active:scale-[0.98] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary/40 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:pointer-events-none;
  }

  .card {
    @apply bg-white border border-border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-6 transition-transform duration-150 ease-out;
  }

  .input {
    @apply w-full h-11 px-4 rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface text-ink focus:border-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/15 transition-colors duration-150;
  }

  .badge {
    @apply inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium;
  }

  .badge-bronze {
    @apply bg-warning/10 text-warning;
  }

  .badge-silver {
    @apply bg-ink-secondary/10 text-ink-secondary;
  }

  .badge-gold {
    @apply bg-warning/10 text-warning;
  }

  .badge-verified {
    @apply bg-primary/10 text-primary;
  }
}

/* Smooth scrolling */
html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

/* ── PREVENT MOBILE INPUT ZOOM ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   iOS Safari & Chrome Android zoom into inputs with font-size < 16px.
   This forces all inputs/textareas to render at 16px on mobile so the
   browser never triggers the auto-zoom.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media screen and (max-width: 768px) {
  input,
  textarea,
  select {
    font-size: 16px !important;
  }
}

/* Custom scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  @apply bg-gray-100 dark:bg-[#232323];
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  @apply bg-primary rounded-full;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  @apply bg-primary rounded-full opacity-80;
}

/* ── FIXED NAV STABILITY ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Forces the browser to promote fixed/sticky elements to their own GPU
   compositing layer. This prevents WebView scroll from ever dragging them.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
nav.fixed,
div.fixed {
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
  transform: translateZ(0);
}

/* ── BOTTOM NAV STABILITY (ALL PLATFORMS) ───────────────────────────────────
   Hard-locks the bottom nav. `transition: none` is critical — without it,
   iOS re-triggers animations during rubber-band bounce causing the nav to
   jiggle and snap back.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
nav[class*="fixed"][class*="bottom-0"] {
  position: fixed !important;
  bottom: 0 !important;
  transform: translateZ(0) !important;
  -webkit-transform: translateZ(0) !important;
  transition: none !important;
  will-change: transform;
}

/* ── IOS PWA SCROLL FIX ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@supports (-webkit-touch-callout: none) {
  html,
  body {
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden; /* body must NOT scroll — this kills the rubber-band */
  }

  #page-scroll-container {
    height: 100%;
    overflow-y: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; /* smooth native iOS scroll feel */
    overscroll-behavior: none;         /* no bounce at scroll edges */
  }
}

.pb-nav {
  padding-bottom: calc(64px + max(env(safe-area-inset-bottom), 16px)) !important;
}

@supports (-webkit-touch-callout: none) {
  nav {
    transform: translateZ(0);
    -webkit-transform: translateZ(0);
    will-change: transform;
  }
}

/* App-mode polish: keeps PWA feeling native without changing app logic.
   Flat surfaces only (design bible section 2 — gradients banned everywhere). */
html.app-mode body {
  background: var(--color-surface) !important;
}

html.dark.app-mode body {
  background: #000000 !important;
}

html.app-mode #page-scroll-container,
html.app-mode #ios-scroll-area {
  background: var(--color-surface);
}

html.dark.app-mode #page-scroll-container,
html.dark.app-mode #ios-scroll-area {
  background: var(--color-background);
}

html.app-mode .bg-white.rounded-2xl {
  border-radius: 1rem;
  border-color: var(--color-border) !important;
}

html.dark.app-mode .bg-white.rounded-2xl {
  border-color: var(--color-border) !important;
}

html.app-mode .bg-white.rounded-xl {
  border-color: var(--color-border) !important;
}

html.dark.app-mode .bg-white.rounded-xl {
  border-color: var(--color-border) !important;
}

html.app-mode nav[class*="fixed"][class*="bottom-0"] {
  border-top-color: var(--color-border) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(17,24,39,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(17,24,39,0.08) !important;
}

html.dark.app-mode nav[class*="fixed"][class*="bottom-0"] {
  border-top-color: var(--color-border) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4) !important;
}

/* Phase 3: app-like motion + touch feel */
@keyframes appRouteEnter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

html.app-mode .app-route-enter {
  animation: appRouteEnter 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

html.app-mode a,
html.app-mode button {
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

html.app-mode a:active,
html.app-mode button:active {
  transform: scale(0.985);
}

html.app-mode .btn-press:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

/* Phase 4: marketplace app-screen treatment (visual-only) — flat surfaces only */
html.app-mode .marketplace-shell {
  background: var(--color-surface) !important;
}

html.dark.app-mode .marketplace-shell {
  background: var(--color-background) !important;
}

.dark .marketplace-shell {
  background: var(--color-background) !important;
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-header {
  backdrop-filter: saturate(150%) blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(150%) blur(8px);
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-header-inner {
  padding-top: max(env(safe-area-inset-top), 4px);
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-top-row {
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-search-input {
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-categories {
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-categories .cat-btn {
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-categories .cat-btn.cat-active {
  box-shadow: none;
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-feed {
  padding-top: 0.8rem !important;
}

html.dark.app-mode .marketplace-feed {
  background: transparent !important;
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-feed > div {
  gap: 1rem;
}

html.app-mode .marketplace-feed .bg-white.rounded-xl,
html.app-mode .marketplace-feed .bg-white.rounded-2xl {
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(17,24,39,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(17,24,39,0.08);
}
styles/mobile.css
/* Mobile-first responsive utilities */

/* Safe area insets for iOS */
.safe-area-inset-top {
  padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
}

.safe-area-inset-bottom {
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
}

.safe-area-inset-left {
  padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left);
}

.safe-area-inset-right {
  padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right);
}

/* Custom scrollbar */
.custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
}

.custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  @apply bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800;
}

.custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  @apply bg-gray-300 dark:bg-gray-600 rounded-full;
}

.custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  @apply bg-gray-400 dark:bg-gray-500;
}

/* Smooth scrolling */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }
}

/* Touch-friendly tap targets */
.tap-target {
  min-height: 44px;
  min-width: 44px;
}

/* Prevent text size adjustment on iOS */
html {
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  -moz-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

/* Prevent pull-to-refresh on mobile */
body {
  overscroll-behavior-y: contain;
}

/* Hide scrollbar but keep functionality */
.hide-scrollbar {
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

/* Shimmer animation for loading */
@keyframes shimmer {
  0% {
    background-position: -200% 0;
  }
  100% {
    background-position: 200% 0;
  }
}

.animate-shimmer {
  animation: shimmer 2s infinite;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  background-size: 200% 100%;
}

/* Mobile-optimized card */
.mobile-card {
  @apply bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700;
  @apply shadow-sm active:shadow-md transition-shadow;
}

/* Touch feedback */
.touch-feedback {
  @apply active:scale-98 transition-transform;
}

/* Gradient text */
.gradient-text {
  @apply bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600;
}

/* Glass morphism */
.glass {
  @apply bg-white/80 dark:bg-gray-900/80 backdrop-blur-lg;
}

/* Responsive text sizes */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .responsive-text-xl {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }
  .responsive-text-2xl {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
  .responsive-text-3xl {
    font-size: 1.875rem;
  }
}

/* Prevent horizontal scroll */
.prevent-scroll {
  overflow-x: hidden;
  width: 100%;
}

/* Mobile-friendly form inputs */
.mobile-input {
  @apply text-base; /* Prevents zoom on iOS */
  @apply min-h-[44px]; /* Touch-friendly */
}

/* Bottom navigation spacing */
.pb-nav {
  padding-bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 4rem);
}

/* Floating action button positioning */
.fab {
  @apply fixed bottom-20 right-4 lg:bottom-8;
  @apply w-14 h-14 rounded-full shadow-lg;
  @apply flex items-center justify-center;
  @apply bg-blue-600 text-white;
  @apply hover:bg-blue-700 active:scale-95;
  @apply transition-all duration-200;
}

/* Sticky header */
.sticky-header {
  @apply sticky top-0 z-30;
  @apply bg-white dark:bg-gray-900;
  @apply border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700;
  @apply backdrop-blur-lg bg-opacity-90 dark:bg-opacity-90;
}

/* Skeleton loading */
.skeleton {
  @apply animate-pulse bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 rounded;
}

.skeleton-text {
  @apply skeleton h-4 w-full mb-2;
}

.skeleton-circle {
  @apply skeleton rounded-full;
}

/* Transition utilities */
.transition-all-fast {
  @apply transition-all duration-150 ease-in-out;
}

.transition-all-smooth {
  @apply transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out;
}

/* Focus visible for accessibility */
*:focus-visible {
  @apply outline-none ring-2 ring-blue-500 ring-offset-2 dark:ring-offset-gray-900;
}

/* Disabled state */
.disabled {
  @apply opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed pointer-events-none;
}

/* Badge */
.badge {
  @apply inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium;
}

.badge-primary {
  @apply bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-400;
}

.badge-success {
  @apply bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400;
}

.badge-warning {
  @apply bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-400;
}

.badge-error {
  @apply bg-red-100 text-red-800 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400;
}

/* Print styles */
@media print {
  .no-print {
    display: none !important;
  }
  
  body {
    background: white;
    color: black;
  }
}
